craft_notes: Sthāyin: purity with oneness-option. Rows: found, join, work. Read aloud: gathering.

lines: Its labour's strength confirms it, each soul meeting itself;
but just then it joins, at the Highest's will,
here all this kalā-throng is pure, which, through
god-aimed ends, realizing self, does its appointed work,
to strive against the world's return.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatkāryasya kartṛtvopodbalanādeḥ pratyātmabhedena upalambhāt sa tu vargaḥ kadācit ekībhavet api īśvarecchayā sāmājikātmanām iva tatra sarvo 'yaṃ kalādivargaḥ śuddhaḥ yaḥ parameśvaraviṣayatayā tatsvarūpalābhānuguṇanijakāryakārī saṃsārapratidvaṃdvitvāt
